name: Schengen Visa / Visa-Free Entry (Up to 90 Days)

requirements.blocker_text: No visa is needed for Schengen-area citizens or nationals of countries on Sweden's visa-exempt list (published by the Swedish government); an official checkable list determines status by nationality.
Passport must be valid for at least 3 months after the visa's expiration date.
Requires medical insurance valid across the Schengen area, covering at least EUR 30,000 for emergencies.
Requires SEK 700 per day of the visit, reduced if accommodation/meals are prepaid or a host provides financial support documentation.

evidence_required.document: Schengen visa application form (119031), for non-exempt nationalities
Proof of funds and return travel

outcome.duration_length: Up to 90 days within any 180-day period

sources.title: Swedish Migration Agency -- Apply for a Schengen visa (visiting Sweden for up to 90 days): visa-exempt list, passport validity, EUR 30,000 medical insurance, SEK 700/day funds requirement, EUR 90 fee

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Sweden). Sweden is a Schengen member; the visa-exempt nationality list is set at the EU level and published by the Swedish government at a linked URL not independently fetched in this pass -- modeled as hard:false since the specific nationality list wasn't captured at tier-1 precision within this file. A separate visitor's residence permit exists for stays over 90 days (a long-stay visit permit, distinct from a Schengen visa) -- not modeled as a separate file here since it is a narrow extension mechanism rather than a distinct settlement pathway.
